desc:
🏒 RHL: real hockey, built from the ice up.  (maybe)

Skate with real momentum. Dangle with the stick. Rip wristers, snappers and one-timers past goalies who actually read the play. This isn't arcade hockey. This is RHL.

MODES
🌲 THE POND: Make your player, drop into 3v3 or 5v5 online, earn XP and gold and unlock kits. Outdoors, day or night.
🥇 ONES: 1v1v1 at one net. Last touch scores. First to 7.
⭐ BE A PRO: Go from junior hockey through the draft to a pro career, with contracts, trades, awards and the press.
🏟️ QUICK PLAY: Up to 5v5 online with friends. CPU players fill the empty spots.

FEATURES
✅ Full rules: offside, icing, penalties, power plays, OT and shootouts
✅ Broadcast presentation: a full experience to soak in
✅ Body checks, poke checks, stick lifts, shot blocks and fights
✅ Full controller support
✅ Coach Randy! (no elaboration)

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite for updates!
